series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Unstable rankings and significant RMSE variation across models suggest using weighted combination with inverse RMSE weighting to leverage consistent performers while avoiding unreliable single-model selection.

reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.8026 shows significant model performance variation; inverse weighting captures performance differences with shrinkage to prevent overfitting
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=true (models have consistent performance across horizons) suggests top-k mean is appropriate for leveraging consistent performers
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=true (kendall_tau=0.2164) suggests consistent per-horizon winners exist, making per-horizon selection valid

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2; ridge overfits with few training windows
